description.pt: Cabeça esférica rígida: atraso interaural de Woodworth e sombra da cabeça de Brown e Duda. Modelo didático, sem orelha externa.
description.en: Rigid spherical head: Woodworth interaural delay and the Brown and Duda head shadow. A teaching model, no pinna.

datasets.name: SADIE II
datasets.note: 20 subjects, SOFA, 44.1/48/96 kHz. Cite the original dataset when used or modified. The record may also hold headphone filters (not checked).

datasets.name: ARI HRTF database
datasets.note: More than 250 subjects, SOFA. Share-alike: derived files keep the licence.

datasets.name: CIPIC HRTF database
datasets.note: 45 subjects. The download page could not be opened on 2026-10-23; confirm the terms before embedding.

datasets.name: AutoEq (measurements)
datasets.note: Aggregator of oratory1990, crinacle, InnerFidelity, Rtings and legacy headphone.com measurements, plus target curves (for example harman_over-ear_2018.csv). The code is MIT; the README says nothing about the licence of the measurements, so each source needs its own check.

datasets.name: eBrIRD (kitchen, restaurant)
datasets.note: Site unreachable on 2026-10-23: licence and download not confirmed.

datasets.name: In-Car McVAMPIRE
datasets.note: Minivan, 14 overhead microphones; includes driving noise.

datasets.name: IR64-CAR
datasets.note: Peugeot 208, 64-channel WAV, 24.1 MB. Needs ambisonic or beamforming rendering (phase 7).

datasets.name: dEchorate
datasets.note: Shoebox laboratory room, 1800 annotated RIRs. Zenodo lists a newer version.

datasets.name: BUT Speech@FIT ReverbDB
datasets.note: 8 to 9 rooms. The retransmitted-speech part needs an LDC licence.

datasets.name: Aachen Impulse Response (AIR)
datasets.note: Site unreachable on 2026-10-23: licence not confirmed.

datasets.name: OpenAIR
datasets.note: Read the licence at the bottom of each item page.

datasets.name: SBAF headphone measurements (superbestaudiofriends)
datasets.note: Built in: 100 models (122 entries by measuring rig, 227 files, 2.3 MB) in backend/data/headphones/sbaf, unchanged, with the notice. Two columns (Hz, dB), 1/6-octave smoothed, normalised to 500-1500 Hz and already compensated with the SBAF curve. Mostly hi-fi headphones; last update of the source: July 2021. The CC BY 4.0 licence is stated in its README (the repository has no LICENSE file).

datasets.name: COAT (HpTF of three headphones on 27 listeners)
datasets.note: Headphone transfer functions measured at the ear (Beyerdynamic DT770 Pro, Sennheiser HD650, Etymotic ER-4PT) at Aachen and Oldenburg, in SOFA; about 130 MB for the HpTFs. PySQA does not read HpTF SOFA files yet.

datasets.name: OPRA (Roon)
datasets.note: Community catalogue of products and EQ compensation curves (started from AutoEq data). It holds equalisation settings, which are not a measured response, so it does not feed this block directly. Share-alike.

datasets.name: squig.link / CrinGraph (crinacle and others)
datasets.note: Open-source graph tool used by many measurers. No official bulk CSV was found; the data licence depends on each site.

datasets.name: RTINGS (raw frequency response)
datasets.note: Graphs on the site; no download option or usage terms were found.

datasets.name: Harman target curves
datasets.note: Target curves of the Harman research (Olive, Welti and others); AutoEq publishes them as CSV. The terms for redistributing the numbers were not confirmed, so PySQA compensates to a flat target only.

scenes_note.pt: Valores de partida escolhidos por PySQA a partir de ordens de grandeza usuais; não são medições de um local. Ajuste-os ao seu caso ou use uma resposta ao impulso medida.
scenes_note.en: Starting values chosen by PySQA from usual orders of magnitude; they are not measurements of any place. Adjust them to your case or use a measured impulse response.
